title: Recuperar capacidade com retenção verificável de releases HML
owner: Codex, solicitado pelo owner nesta thread
planned_removals: Old reconstructible HML standalone release directories only when their source files match an immutable Git commit and their plan remains unchanged
acceptance_criteria: A dry-run inventory identifies verified HML artifacts and preserves unknown, modified, non-SHA and symbolic release directories
The active, previous and four newest releases are protected independently of modification time
Applying requires the SHA-256 of the reviewed plan and revalidates current/previous pointers and source provenance before removal
The tool refuses production roots and persistent files, and does not follow junctions into shared storage
A successful HML deploy records its previous release and applies the same conservative retention
HML runtime health and active release remain unchanged after storage recovery, and the unchanged 25 GiB disk/3 GiB build RAM gate is rechecked
required_tests: Real temporary Git repositories exercise protected releases, unknown/tampered source, stale plan refusal, symlink isolation, dry-run and actual removal
Node syntax check, scoped tests, PowerShell parser validation on the VM, diff review
Record redacted HML capacity, plan hash, removal receipt, active identity and health evidence
